summary: Hugging Face model card for FunctionGemma, a 270M Gemma 3-based open model for function calling intended for fine-tuning. Reports BFCL function-calling scores, a Mobile Actions fine-tuning comparison and on-device latency, and a qualitative ethics & safety section (child safety, content safety, representational harms) with no numbers.

evals: Structured evaluations and internal red-teaming: Content Safety (harassment, violence and gore, hate speech)
harmful_content_refusal.finding: Qualitative: major improvements and minimal policy violations vs previous Gemma; no numbers.
harmful_content_refusal.quote: The model produced minimal policy violations, and showed significant improvements over previous Gemma models' performance with respect to ungrounded inferences.

jailbreak_robustness.finding: Red teaming by multiple teams; no results.
jailbreak_robustness.quote: Red-teaming was conducted by a number of different teams, each with different goals and human evaluation metrics.

honesty_hallucination.quote: They may generate incorrect or outdated factual statements.

bias_fairness.finding: Representational harms (bias, stereotyping) evaluated; improvement claimed; no numbers.
bias_fairness.quote: **Representational Harms:** Evaluation of text-to-text and image to text prompts covering safety policies including bias, stereotyping, and harmful associations or inaccuracies.

child_safety.finding: Child safety evaluated; improvement claimed; no numbers.
child_safety.quote: **Child Safety:** Evaluation of text-to-text and image to text prompts covering child safety policies, including child sexual abuse and exploitation.

privacy.finding: PII/sensitive data filtered from training data.
privacy.quote: Models were trained on data filtered for removal of PII (Personally Identifiable Information).

multilingual_safety.finding: Explicitly not covered: safety evals were English-only.
multilingual_safety.quote: A limitation of our evaluations was they included only English language prompts.

system_safeguards.finding: Safeguards delegated to developers; Gemma Prohibited Use Policy.
system_safeguards.quote: Developers are encouraged to exercise caution and implement appropriate content safety safeguards based on their specific product policies and application use cases.

self_reported_limitations.text: Safety evaluations included only English-language prompts.

notes: HF card md has page markers; used where available. Ethics/safety text appears to be the standard Gemma template (mentions image-to-text prompts though the model is text-only). No function-calling-specific safety (e.g., harmful tool actions, prompt injection) evaluated.
